color.note: Dark only — the brand has one theme. Warm near-blacks, warm off-white inks, one ember red used as atmosphere and accent. Chrome (a light-metal gradient in bundle.css) is the primary-action colour.

tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: Page background — the outer canvas behind every screen.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and terminal-window bodies sitting above bg-canvas; the base under a .surface-ember glow.

tokens.name: bg-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Elevated surfaces — the nav once scrolled, the terminal title bar, dialogs, toasts.

tokens.name: bg-code
tokens.usage: Background of code blocks and terminal panes, nested a shade darker than the surface that holds them.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative 1px dividers, timeline rails and default card edges. Not relied on alone to mark an interactive boundary (1.3:1).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Functional borders — terminal inputs, the toast edge, dashed upcoming timeline markers, the io spans in a trace. 3.6:1 on bg-canvas, 3.4:1 on bg-surface.

tokens.name: border-outline
tokens.usage: The 1px edge of outline buttons, form inputs and icon buttons. 7:1 on bg-canvas, 4:1 at the brightest point of a .surface-ember glow.

tokens.name: ink-primary
tokens.usage: Headings and primary body copy on bg-canvas, bg-surface and bg-surface-raised (15:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, descriptions, nav links and the dimmed second line of a section title, on bg-canvas and bg-surface (8.4:1+), and on the .surface-ember glow peak (5:1).

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Meta text — timestamps, placeholders, dates, the resting tech-marquee logos — on bg-canvas and bg-surface (5.2:1+) and bg-surface-raised (4.85:1).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on chrome — the primary button, the solid pill, the Now badge. 12.5:1 or better across the whole chrome gradient.

tokens.name: ember-300
tokens.usage: Ember text and icons on dark grounds — a hovered link, form error text, small accent marks. 6.1:1+ on bg-canvas and bg-surface.

tokens.name: ember-400
tokens.usage: The section-number ember, the terminal prompt caret, the current timeline marker, list-bullet ticks and invalid-input borders. 4.52:1 on bg-canvas; only 4.27:1 on bg-surface — kept exact from the source, so set ember-400 text at 24px+ or use ember-300 on bg-surface.

tokens.name: ember-500
tokens.usage: The brand's ember — the ambient glow behind hero and card surfaces (.surface-ember), the active-state dot, the first terminal dot, ::selection. Not a button fill: primary actions are chrome. Paired with on-ember whenever text sits on it.

tokens.name: ember-600
tokens.usage: Pressed / active state for ember-500 fills; the dark end of the trace span gradient.

tokens.name: on-ember
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ember-500 (5:1) or ember-600 (7.5:1) fill, e.g. selected text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and error fills — an alias of ember-500 so errors read as the same red as the brand accent. For error TEXT use ember-300.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on bg-canvas and bg-surface (6.8:1+) — the status pill, sent confirmations, INFO log levels, the live-clock dot.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on bg-canvas and bg-surface (8.8:1+) — WARN log levels, the middle terminal dot.

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords and HTTP verbs in code-block and terminal previews. Alias of ember-400: 4.46:1 on bg-code, just under 4.5 — kept from the source; use at 500 weight.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: String literals in code-block and terminal previews, on bg-code (8.9:1).

tokens.name: code-function
tokens.usage: Function names, and the key labels of the terminal contact form, on bg-code and bg-surface (9.9:1+).

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Comments — '// or email me directly' — in code-block and terminal previews, on bg-code.

tokens.name: code-punctuation
tokens.usage: Punctuation and operators in code-block and terminal previews, on bg-code.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Space Grotesk (Google Fonts, 300–700). Set light (400); wrap the one or two words that carry the claim in a 600-weight span.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.sample: Engineering backend systems for AI products.
styles.usage: The hero headline — one per page. On the site it runs fluid: clamp(40px, 4.4vw, 84px).

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Sub-hero statements, the contact headline and large stat figures.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.sample: Where I’ve built & what comes next
styles.usage: Section titles — Work, Experience, Contact. Light (400), often on two lines with the second in ink-secondary.

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: Card and panel titles — a project name.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Minor headings — a timeline role, an archive project name.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans (Google Fonts, 400–700) for all running copy.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: I’m a CS student at Goldsmiths building with Python, FastAPI and LLMs.
styles.usage: Hero sub-copy and lede paragraphs, in ink-secondary, max 46ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Roles, study and builds in order.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Flags telecom customers likely to leave so retention teams can act first.
styles.usage: Card descriptions, form helper text, list items, buttons (at 500).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, field hints and errors, small meta text.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono (Google Fonts, 400–600) — the engineering voice: eyebrows, pills, terminal copy, meta lines.

styles.name: code-label
styles.usage: Wide-tracked UPPERCASE eyebrow above a section title and the key of a fact pair. Set text-transform: uppercase in use.

styles.name: code-block
styles.usage: Code and terminal body copy; the contact form's inputs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a pill's items, a button's icon and label; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls — button groups, pill rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default internal padding for compact components — buttons, inputs, terminal bars.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and terminal-body padding; gap between a card's header and body.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid; nav link gap; section sub-blocks.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between a section's label and its content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between major page blocks; mobile section padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section-to-section padding on desktop; the stagger offset of even project cards.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Code blocks and terminal panes — kept square against the mono grid.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, square icon buttons, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The screenshot inset inside a ProjectCard media panel; small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, media panels, terminal windows, the floating nav and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills and badges, circular icon buttons, timeline markers, the terminal window's traffic-light dots.

shadow.note: Dark-UI shadows are stacked (contact, near, ambient). Glows replace shadow-md on hover — never stack both.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting elevation for badges and small controls.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Cards, media panels and terminal windows at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, toasts, the hero terminal and the scrolled nav.

tokens.name: shadow-glow-ember
tokens.usage: The ember glow — hover on a ProjectCard media panel. Replaces shadow-md.

tokens.name: shadow-glow-chrome
tokens.usage: Hover on chrome — the primary button and nav CTA. A cool light halo, never red.

tokens.name: shadow-bevel
tokens.usage: The machined-edge highlight on metal and chrome surfaces. Always paired with a metal or chrome gradient, never a flat fill.

tokens.name: shadow-focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on every interactive element. Kept exact from the source, but it composites to ~2:1 on bg-canvas and bg-surface — below the 3:1 floor; the brightened ink-primary border on inputs carries focus there.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page side padding for .container, fluid from phone to wide desktop.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max content width inside the gutters.

tokens.name: marquee-h
tokens.usage: Height of the tech marquee strip; the desktop hero fills 100svh minus this.
